notes.title: Devlog: Weapon Feature Breakdown
notes.content:
Weapon Feature Breakdown
As we are approaching the release of the game (set for late 2025), we have been creating a series of promotional videos for Let Them Come: Onslaught!

As part of these teaser videos, here are the weapon overviews for the Photon Saber, the Shotgun and the Electric grenades! You can watch a compilation of these three videos where we break down some tips and strategies for each weapon :


[previewyoutube="aPTqpY67D8I;full"][/previewyoutube]

Photon Saber

Starts with a single short swing, forcing you to close the gap on foes. Leveling up unlocks a second swing, a wide-area spinning attack, and a rear‑push short spin to keep enemies at bay. All animations and hit boxes are authored directly in Unreal Engine, ensuring frame‑perfect timing and collision.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/f6fd6d266499632b2afecfb2c01143018b5a6bf1.gif"]

The Shotgun

Designed for precision pushback: only enemies struck by the blast are sent flying. Its shorter range is offset by strong damage and the unlockable double shot. It can cripple targets to slow their advance and trigger critical blasts for extra pushback, pairing exceptionally well with high‑damage, low‑pushback weapons like electric grenades or the flamethrower.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/8e9d65e7d587e13d240b344897635dc0e0f4dd21.gif"]


Electric Grenades

At level one, its random trajectory and small radius make it deceptively weak. Fully upgraded, it launches three high‑radius grenades in quick succession, turning it into a DPS powerhouse. It’s best used alongside weapons that offer strong pushback to prevent swarms of enemies from overrunning you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/04873b9025caf16faf774fd767a9f7560c7af35b.gif"]

Wishlist and stay tuned for deep dives and strategic tips as we continue to expand Let Them Come: Onslaught!

notes.title: New Demo OUT NOW! Plus New Partnership Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello Again Survivors!

We can't wait to launch Let Them Come: Onslaught! Only a few more months to go!
More details on a specific date will be announced soon.

In the meantime, We are excited to announce that the updated demo for Let Them Come: Onslaught is now available!
This demo offers a fresh experience with new content and a ton of improvements! Check out the new Demo and Trailer below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050800/Let_Them_Come_Onslaught?snr=100600_703_dashboard_

[previewyoutube=WYFY1ksoC3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

New Partnership: Digital Bandidos

We are also thrilled to announce that Digital Bandidos. has joined us as the publisher for Let Them Come: Onslaught! Key members of that team were involved as publishers for the first Let Them Come game. Their expertise and shared passion for this franchise make them the perfect partner as we move toward release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/d45434e55b3d4afd6d839579cf0ae97deb41ca9f.gif

New Demo! 

The latest demo update is now live. It introduces new weapons, a new boss, and the a brand new redesign of the Armory. This update also includes significant balance and optimization improvements, refined gameplay and performance, and improved visuals.

New Weapons and a New Boss Fight

There are 3 new weapons in this version of the demo. One is available from the start, and the others must be unlocked!
There is also a new boss fight that awaits those who can survive the storm and endure the endless waves of enemies. Reaching it is only half the battle, you’ll need to be strong enough to take it down within the time limit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/abeadaa885ed0880f1cdd2cf29d87bc97b9c5876.gif

New Armory 

The Armory is where you upgrade you can purchase various upgrades to customize your build. As you complete achievements, more upgrades become available. Invest in Offense to boost damage and weapon efficiency, Utility to improve movement, pickup range, and XP gain, or Survivability to increase max HP and defense. Each upgrade costs in-game credits, but you can also refund your upgrades at anytime if you want to try different upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/eda7fd9363bbd03177a27b97f57e4d88a33959d7.gif

1.0 Release

As we approach the finish line, our focus is on adding new content, balancing, and polishing the game. Stay tuned for the full launch later this year to discover more maps, playable characters, weapons, and more… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/b1d2d15cbbfd1703bfa08a0687925d65480c3a42.gif

You can use the "Share Feedback" button on the main menu of the game to fill a survey about your experience.

You can also reach out to our team and chat with the Let Them Come community here on Steam forums or on our Discord server

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that played the demo and shared their feedback with us!
We have been paying close attention to the Feedback Survey results, and to the conversations on our Steam Forum and Discord page.

Here are the updates we made to the demo.

Fewer "Manual Aiming" Weapons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/05401075e760695052229227986a0dd93b1a3dd2.gif

Reading players' feedback made us realize that we had too many "Manual Aiming" weapons in our current arsenal.

With this update, we are hoping to strike a better balance.
More weapons are now Auto-Aiming, and we are keeping one Manual Aiming weapon that expert players can still use if they want.

Let us know what you think of these changes!

Proper Options Menu

Back when we launched the demo we didn't really have time to build a proper Options Menu.
It only allowed volume control and nothing else.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/6032bb0526d4fe13314ae1f991838bf0437ae7c4.png
We are happy to announce that we now have a more fleshed out Options Menu!
This should allow you to adjust the game's settings to your liking, but it is still work in progress.
Please, feel free to let us know if you are encountering issues with this menu, or if you think some specific options are missing!

Reset Progress

For those of you that have played the demo a lot already and want to experience this update with a fresh save file, we also added the option to delete your progress in the Settings Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357789/b159a351a8d5be97237322ee47b147ee3a6163a3.jpg

More Improvements

We also added lots of various improvements in this update. 
- New music track in the Armory (banger!)
- Improved the visuals and sound of the lightning strikes in the level
- Performance improvements
And many other small changes.

More to Come

Now that this update is out, we will be focusing once again on creating new content for the game!
We can't wait to show you more as we get closer to our Early Access launch.

In the meantime, if you want to help us make this game as good as it can be, please keep sharing your feedback in the Feedback Survey or by making posts in the Steam Forum or our Discord.
